races.race_name: 1xBet.ie Proud Partners Of Irish Sport Irish EBF Maiden

runners.name: Bold Commander
runners.spotlight: Well-bred No Nay Never colt was a 6.5l fifth on debut at Cork when stable second string (6f, good, 6-1); dropped back to 5f at Bellewstown and improved on his initial effort when a 2.5l second of eight (good); obvious chance with Moore up for the first time, but by no means unbeatable at the same time.
runners.comment: Well-bred colt was second over 5f last time; obvious chance but not unbeatable either
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Abletai
runners.spotlight: Took a huge step forward when getting to within a head of Carry The Flag in his second career start dropped back to 5f at Naas in May (good, 80-1); ran keenly when 6l behind Carry The Flag in a Naas Listed race earlier this month; down in grade now and claims on the basis of his penultimate run; holds a Group 1 entry here and sets the standard on 93.
runners.comment: Huge improvement when beaten a head in second maiden; too keen in a Listed race latest

runners.name: Litmus Test
runners.spotlight: 160,000gns yearling finished second of six behind an Aidan O'Brien-trained odds-on chance at Dundalk on debut (5f); shaped like he will have learned plenty from that and a tongue tie and cheekpieces have been added; in the mix.
runners.comment: Second behind odds-on shot on debut and shaped like he learned plenty; chance

runners.name: Brageiro
runners.spotlight: Blue Point filly; 120,000euros yearling; half-sister to 7f 2yo winner Down The Glen (RPR 73); dam 1m AW winner (70), half-sister to winners Flaming Spear (1m Listed), Taqseem (UAE 5f Listed) and Desert Blossom (useful 7f 2yo), out of Group-placed 7f 2yo winner; best watched unless market speaks.
runners.comment: Blue Point filly cost 120,000euros as yearling; half-sister to 2yo winner Down The Glen

runners.name: Star Above Me
runners.spotlight: 42,000euros yearling; (30,000gns vendor 2yo); dam unplaced 5f/6f (RPR 58), sister to 5f winner Heiba, half-sister to winners Golden Stunner (useful 7f/1m) and Colonel Carter (1m-1m2f), out of half-sister to dam of top miler Canford Cliffs; best watched for the moment.
runners.comment: Dam unplaced, sister to 5f winner Heiba; best watched for the moment

runners.name: La Tache
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; has started slowly in both runs to date; improved on his moderate debut over 6f here in June when a 1.25l fourth of eight at Fairyhouse in first-time blinkers (retained) earlier this month (6f, good); drops to 5f, but may get involved if getting away quicker.
runners.comment: Started slowly in both runs to date; drops to 5f but may get involved with a faster start

runners.name: Atlantic Bridge
runners.spotlight: 10,000euros foal, 23,000euros yearling; bought for 300,000euros at a Breeze-Up in May; ninth foal; half-brother to four winners inc Ruby's Profit (5f inc 2yo/AW; RPR 97), Miss Power (5f; 95) and Between Hills (6f 2yo; 94); dam Listed placed over 5f as 2yo but did not win (92?); holds Group 1 entries here; yard does well with juveniles, but is a little cold at the moment.
runners.comment: Bought for 300,000euros at a Breeze-Up in May; yard does well with juveniles

runners.name: Invincible Irish
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam 5f-1m maiden (RPR 65), sister to Listed-placed 5f/6f winner Gold Filigree, out of 5f 2yo winning half-sister to 1m Group 2 winner Emerald Commander; not super appealing on paper.
runners.comment: Maiden dam, sister to Listed-placed 5f/6f winner Gold Filigree; not so appealing on paper

runners.name: Southern Boulevard
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; No Nay Never filly cost 110,000euros as a yearling; relatively unfancied for her Naas debut (5f, good) and was beaten 9l; improvement probable but Keane rides La Tache.
runners.comment: Unfancied on debut and beaten 9l; improvement likely but Keane rides La Tache

runners.name: The Drambling Man
runners.spotlight: Hung right when sixth over 5f on debut at Cork (soft); well beaten when upped to 6.5f at Listowel next time; a bit better back over 5f at Bellewstown last time; hood goes on, but a lot of improvement needed.
runners.comment: Middling efforts in three maidens; a lot of improvement needed

runners.name: My Irish Lady
runners.spotlight: Minzaal filly cost 160,000euros as a yearling; well beaten on debut when sixth of seven and 3.5l behind Southern Boulevard; others more likely.
runners.comment: Well beaten on debut when sixth of seven; others more likely

runners.name: Stellar Path
runners.spotlight: Has beaten just one rival in two maiden runs over 5f/6.5f on different ground; tongue tie on but of no appeal.
runners.comment: Beat just one rival in two maidens; of no appeal

races.race_name: Cavalor Equine Nutrition Irish EBF Fillies Maiden

runners.name: White Sand Beach
runners.spotlight: Placed six times in maidens from 7f-11.5f on different ground; longer trip didn't bring improvement from her at Killarney last time when again runner-up (11.5f, good); she's expensive to follow, but  sets the standard and her day is sure to come someday soon.
runners.comment: Placed six times in maidens; expensive to follow, but sets standard and her day is coming
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Cape Primrose
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly is rated 76 after four starts; went close at Thurles on her second and final start last term (1m, good to yielding); hasn't really progressed in two runs this year, the latest in cheekpieces at Naas (10.5f, good); Moore rides White Sand Beach.
runners.comment: Hasn't shown progression in two runs this season; Moore rides White Sand Beach
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Mathoura
runners.spotlight: Calyx filly made a positive impression when running green but taking the runner-up spot ahead of subsequent winner Vauntingly at Gowran (1m2f, good); only an 8l third at Fairyhouse next time (1m2f, good), but was 2l behind the runner-up Mai Dahlia, who won easily next time; interesting.
runners.comment: Good impression when second on debut; behind an easy subsequent winner when third latest

runners.name: Star Performer
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; Sea The Stars filly; 75,000yearling, 160,000euros 2yo; second foal; dam 5f/6f winner (inc 2yo/AW/German Group 3; RPR 101), half-sister to winners Back To Brussels (Listed-placed 5f 2yo/6f) and Green Sense (6f 2yo Group 2), is granddaughter of US 6f Listed winner; appeals on paper and chosen by Browne McMonagle.
runners.comment: Sea The Stars filly; dam 5f/6f winner (inc 2yo); appeal on paper and stable selected

runners.name: Mosel
runners.spotlight: Second foal; half-sister to French Listed-placed 6f-7f winner Summer Sail (RPR 103); dam unraced half-sister to 6f-1m winner Beau Jardine, out of Listed-placed 7f/1m winner; Browne McMonagle rides Star Performer.
runners.comment: Half-sister to winner Summer Sail (RPR 103); stable second string

runners.name: Storm Petrel
runners.spotlight: Down the field on her only juvenile start, but much better on her return at Rocommon last month when fourth of 12 (7.5f, good); ran green that day so could improve again, but will need to.
runners.comment: Good fourth on seasonal return; ran green so could improve, but will need to

runners.name: Sunatia
runners.spotlight: Slowly away when beaten 17l on debut over 1m at Naas; likely needs more time.
runners.comment: Slowly away when beaten 17l on debut over 1m at Naas; likely needs more time
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Trumph
runners.spotlight: Beaten 21l on debut at Leopardstown in October (7f, yielding); huge improvement needed.
runners.comment: Beaten 21l on debut at Leopardstown in October (7f, yielding); huge improvement needed

races.race_name: 1xBet.ie Supporting Irish Sport Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Ibelieveicanfly
runners.spotlight: Well clear of fifth-placed Citrus Springs when ridden by Ryan Moore on her debut at Leopardstown; had Wayne Lordan aboard when chasing home Moore's mount Alpha over C&D three weeks ago; form was given a strong boost by a win for Livenka at Fairyhouse last week.
runners.comment: Form of C&D second was given a strong boost by a win for Livenka at Fairyhouse this week.
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Flaxman S

runners.name: Admired Beauty
runners.spotlight: Blue Point filly; third foal; dam French 1m2f winner, closely related to Australian 6.5f Group 2 winner Home Of The Brave.
runners.comment: Blue Point filly, dam French 1m2f winner, closely related to an Australian Group 2 winner

runners.name: Sword Of State
runners.spotlight: 10,500gns yearling; eleventh foal; half-sister by State Of Rest to five winners, best of them a 7f Listed scorer.
runners.comment: Half-sister by State Of Rest to five winners, best of them a 7f Listed scorer

runners.name: Beach
runners.spotlight: Half-sister by No Nay Never to three winners, including Concert Hall, a Group 3-winning filly for this stable; dam, by Galileo, won the Oaks, sister to Group 3 winners at 1m2f and 1m6f; a leading apprentice aboard, but looks like the yard's third string.
runners.comment: Half-sister to a Group 3-winning filly, dam won the Oaks, looks like yard's third-string
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Fly Smartly
runners.spotlight: Mehmas filly; E135,000 yearling; dam 7f 2yo winner; finished 1 1/4l in front of her shorter-priced stablemate Shi Yang when third of seven in a 5f maiden at Navan early this month.
runners.comment: Finished 1 1/4l in front of her shorter-priced stablemate Shi Yang when third at Navan

runners.name: Green Sparkle
runners.spotlight: E120,000 Y; seventh foal; Lope De Vega filly is closely related to 5f AW winner Real Encounter, half-sister to four winners, including Real Appeal (eight wins, including a 1m Group 2); champion jockey prefers the once-raced Citrus Springs.
runners.comment: Yard's second string, closely related to a 5f winner, half-sister to a 1m Group 2 winner

runners.name: Shi Yang
runners.spotlight: 6-4 favourite on debut over 5f at Naas last month, weakened late into fifth; failed to improve as much as might have been expected when fourth over the same course and trip on second start, 1 1/4 behind her bigger-priced stablemate Fly Smart.
runners.comment: Both runs over 5f at Naas, 1 1/4 behind her longer-priced stablemate Fly Smart last time

runners.name: Speckles
runners.spotlight: Half-sister by No Nay Never to Listed winner Boogie Woogie; dam won the Irish and Yorkshire Oaks; half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Crusade; Ryan Moore on Ibelieveicanfly.
runners.comment: No Nay Never filly, dam won the Irish and Yorkshire Oaks, Ryan Moore on Ibelieveicanfly
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Alpine Wedding
runners.spotlight: Satisfactory debut at Leopardstown, but has 4 1/2l to find with Ibelieveicanfly who has picked up further experience into the bargain.
runners.comment: Satisfactory debut at Leopardstown but has 4 1/2l to find with Ibelieveicanfly

runners.name: Citrus Springs
runners.spotlight: Olympiad filly cost 65,000USD as a yearling, 300,000USD at Ocala in March; needs to step up considerably from her Listowel debut seven weeks ago.
runners.comment: Needs to step up considerably from her Listowel debut seven weeks ago

races.race_name: Glenroyal Hotel And Shoda Cafe Minstrel Stakes (Group 2)

runners.name: Power Blue
runners.spotlight: Won a Group 1 over 6f here on his final juvenile start (good); runner-up behind subsequent Royal Ascot and Group 1 winner on his reappearance in a Group 3 over 7f at Leopardstown in April (good to yielding); probably not up to the top level as shown in three Group 1 runs over 1m since, but his latest two were meritable; big danger dropping in class and trip; top rated of the field too; stable a little cold currently though.
runners.comment: Gr.1 winner here last term; big danger dropping in class and trip now; top-rated too

runners.name: Dorset
runners.spotlight: Won three times as a juvenile, including the valuable Goffs Million over course and distance; finished 2.5l behind Power Blue on seasonal return at Leopardstown when seventh of 11 (7f, good to yielding); faced a tough task in the French 2,000 Guineas; weakened into a modest ninth in the Jersey Stakes last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Three-time juvenile winner inc' C&D Goffs Million; middling form this term

runners.name: East Hampton
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden over 6f here in 2024 (yielding to soft) and bagged the Madrid handicap at Naas last season (7f, soft to heavy); best run since was when beaten a neck by Diego Velazquez in this race last year (good to yielding); beaten 1.5l behind Big Gossey in a C&D Listed race on return (soft to heavy); not at his best at Leopardstown last time; appears to give his best on softer ground.
runners.comment: Best run last season was when a neck second in this race; gives best on softer

runners.name: Big Gossey
runners.spotlight: Entering legendary course specialist status after adding a tenth win at the venue in a Listed race last time (6f, good); prior to that he won a C&D Listed contest in March (soft to heavy) when seeing off East Hampton by 1.5l; got closest to subsequent Group 1 winner Comanche Brave when a 2l second in a 6f Group 2 here on penultimate (good); always a danger around here and should go well again.
runners.comment: Course specialist added tenth course win latest; always a danger here and should go well

runners.name: Zodiac Bear
runners.spotlight: Okay fourth in the Group 3 Ballycorus Stakes at Leopardstown on return (7f, soft) and built on that when making all and keeping on well to win a 1m Listed race here last time (good); cheekpieces added and drop back to 7f should be okay; having just his sixth career run so improvement still feasible.
runners.comment: Won a 1m Listed race here last time; 7f okay and progress feasible for lightly raced sort

runners.name: Duckadilly
runners.spotlight: Gained first win at stakes level when taking a Listed fillies' event at Navan last month (1m, good); found wanting in a deeper race over 1m here on Irish Derby weekend next time; resumed winning ways when landing a Group 3 at Leopardstown last time (7f, good), however, the proximity of an 83-rated rival (1l) to her takes the sheen off the form a bit.
runners.comment: Has won a Listed and a Group 3 race this term but ran moderately here on penultimate

runners.name: Audience
runners.spotlight: Group 1 Lockinge winner in 2024 and Group 2 winner at Goodwood the same year; on a losing run since but his runner-up finish in a Leopardstown Group 3 showed definite signs of encouragement (7f, soft) when ridden by Keane for the first time; his wins came on good so if he repeats that latest run he is firmly in the mix.
runners.comment: Winless since 2024 but latest second was highly encouraging; danger with  a repeat

races.race_name: Racing World 50th Anniversary Irish EBF Fillies Handicap

runners.name: Mallavelly
runners.spotlight: Three wins last season, including handicaps at Leopardstown (1m, good to firm) and Tipperary (7.5f, good); out of her depth in a Group 3 on seasonal debut; below form on soft at Leopardstown; much more like it on quick going over 7f here last time, chasing home one of the stars of the season, Meriden, who has won a Listed race to complete a five-timer; strong chance.
runners.comment: Looks the part following a second placing behind the outstandingly progressive Meriden

runners.name: Glitter And Glory
runners.spotlight: Rarely runs a bad race; won a maiden at Dundalk in March; not beaten far in a 7f handicap at this venue in May; second in a small-field conditions race at Leopardstown, before third behind the same winner in a Killarney handicap on Monday; first-time cheekpieces; 2lb wrong, but good 5lb claimer.
runners.comment: Rarely runs a bad race, first-time cheekpieces, 2lb out of the handicap, good 5lb claimer

runners.name: Pink Oxalis
runners.spotlight: Four wins last year, including this event; career best when landing a highly competitive fillies' handicap at Leopardstown in September; has run five times this season, only once showing her best form; two lesser displays since a creditable third placing at Gowran in April; 10lb higher than 12 months ago.
runners.comment: Now 10lb higher than winning this race last year, needs to step up on this season's form

runners.name: Sanctijude
runners.spotlight: Consistent in maidens and handicaps before breakthrough win in a 1m maiden at Gowran on her tenth start; got away with a 2lb rise but her chance was dismissed by punters when she ran in a 1m1f premier handicap here three weeks ago; 33-1 then, not disgraced in mid-division after meeting trouble in running; visor replaces cheekpieces worn then.
runners.comment: Took her a while to win a maiden, fair run in a 1m1f premier handicap here three weeks ago

runners.name: Orchidaceae
runners.spotlight: Won twice as a juvenile, including over 6f at this venue; won a 7f Fairyhouse handicap last year; well below that level on final two starts of the campaign; looked an awkward ride on her reappearance in a 7f premier handicap here last month; may simply have been ring-rusty; should improve from the run, and first-time cheekpieces may help.
runners.comment: Should improve from last month's seasonal debut and first-time cheekpieces may help

runners.name: Kirkland Sioux
runners.spotlight: Failed to make an impact in three maidens at 7f/1m; no significant improvement when upped to 1m4f for her handicap debut at Limerick; a different story when tackling an extended 1m on better ground at Fairyhouse, travelled well and took command under two furlongs down to score easily; has turned a corner and can remain competitive despite a 12lb rise.
runners.comment: Has turned a corner and can remain competitive despite a 12lb rise for Fairyhouse win

races.race_name: 1xBet.ie Proud Supporters Of Irish Racing Curragh Cup (Group 2)

runners.name: Al Riffa
runners.spotlight: Won this event by 5l last year as a prelude to a handsome Irish St Leger success, adding to Group 1 wins in the 2022 National Stakes and in Germany in 2024; finished seventh of 24 in last year's Melbourne Cup; best of three runs this season when third in a Group 1 event over almost 2m at Longchamp; back in his comfort zone trip-wise after Ascot Gold Cup fourth.
runners.comment: Last year's winner, Irish St Leger winner, back in comfort zone after Ascot Gold Cup run

runners.name: Illinois
runners.spotlight: 2024 Queen's Vase winner; second in last year's Gold Cup at Royal Ascot (good to firm) and runner-up again in the Goodwood Cup (2m, good); flopped when favourite for the Irish St Leger won by Al Riffa; satisfactory return in Ormonde at Chester before a dismal Coronation Cup run; bounced back from that when landing the Queen Alexandra.
runners.comment: High-class but not exactly dependable, good Cup form last year, Queen Alexandra winner
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Happy Pharoah
runners.spotlight: Strong form at Leopardstown last season, winning three times, including a Listed contest and premier handicap (both over 1m5f on good to yielding); never a factor in the Irish Cesarewitch; unsuited by very soft ground here on seasonal debut; fine effort when runner-up to Scandinavia in the Saval Beg at Leopardstown (1m6f, good).
runners.comment: Fine effort when runner-up to Scandinavia in the Saval Beg at Leopardstown; big task here

runners.name: Tennessee Stud
runners.spotlight: Group 1-winning 2yo; made the frame last year in the Derby/Irish Derby and career-best when winning the Group 2 Prix Chaudenay (1m7f, very soft) at Longchamp in October; disappointing in a Group 2 Riyadh contest in January; fair third in a 2m Listed race at Down Royal in May.
runners.comment: Won a 1m7f Group 2 Prix event in France last season, helps to give trainer a strong hand

runners.name: Floresta
runners.spotlight: Progressive last season, two wins included a Listed contest at Leopardstown (1m6f, good); signed off with creditable fifth in the Group 2 Park Hill at Doncaster; bounced back from a poor comeback run at Gowran to land a Group 3 contest over 1m6f at Fairyhouse 11 days ago; stamina assured.
runners.comment: Poor run at Gowran before landing a recent 1m6f contest at Fairyhouse, stamina assured

runners.name: Dallas Star
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner over 1m2f at three; his losing run now stands at 14 since a Dundalk win early last year; flattered by his proximity to star stayer Scandinavia in a 1m6f Listed race at Navan in April; remote seventh behind Illinois in the Queen Alexandra.
runners.comment: On a long losing streak, a remote seventh behind Illinois in the Queen Alexandra.

runners.name: Trustyourinstinct
runners.spotlight: Seven wins on the Flat, also a winning hurdler; landed Gowran conditions race (9.5f, yielding) for a third time last month; has chased home the smart Purview on two occasions at this venue this season; got closer over 1m2f three weeks ago, than in a 1m4f event in May.
runners.comment: Smart type but not in the same league as stablemate Al Riffa and a less established stayer

runners.name: Green Impact
runners.spotlight: Beat the top-class Delacroix in a Leopardstown Group 2 as a juvenile; sixth in last season's 2,000 Guineas before making all in a 1m1f Leopardstown Listed race last June; respectable efforts in the Irish Derby and in a York Group 2 (10.5f, good); stamina not assured, judged on overall profile and two runs this season, the most recent when well held fourth in the Tattersalls Gold Cup.
runners.comment: Very capable sort, stamina not assured judged on overall profile and two runs this season

races.race_name: James Nolan Bar Kildare Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Tradewinds
runners.spotlight: Ordinary run on debut at Navan (6f, good); much better when a 2l third at this venue (6f, good to yielding); well held in second at Down Royal (5f, soft); cheekpieces tried now after an inconclusive third placing at Bellewstown.
runners.comment: Placed twice over 5f since a C&D third that arguably constitutes his best form

runners.name: Lars Soldier
runners.spotlight: First three runs were at this venue, big improvement on the second occasion to beat the highly-regarded Confucius in a 5f maiden on testing ground; upped to 6f in Group 3 Marble Hill, finished fifth of seven after racing keenly; made a lot of the running before fading into third in a 6f Fairyhouse conditions event; gelded since then.
runners.comment: Has kept good company, plenty of weight for his handicap debut, could be vulnerable

runners.name: Woodlawn Lily
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far when fourth of six on debut at Cork (5f, soft); has struggled twice since then; stable is having a fine season, but juveniles have not contributed significantly so far.
runners.comment: Not a bad run first time out on soft ground at Cork, has struggled twice since then

runners.name: Belle Island
runners.spotlight: Ran to a useful level when second and third in two AW maidens; has finished last in two turf attempts; highly tried in a Listed race last time; not entirely ruled out.
runners.comment: Shaped promisingly in two Dundalk runs, last on both turf starts, highly tried last time
runners.owner: Gary Devlin & N W T Dalzell

runners.name: I Ready
runners.spotlight: Similar standard of form in 6f maiden at the Curragh (good) on debut and when fifth in a median sires series race at Fairyhouse (6f, good); needs to find more to get his head in front; headgear.
runners.comment: Mid-field at Navan on latest just behind Lucy's Promise, cheekpieces and Colin Keane now

runners.name: Desert Alchemist
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut at Cork (6f, soft); failed to build on that when soundly beaten at Naas over 5f on quicker ground; fair sixth over C&D last month.
runners.comment: Placed on debut at Cork, moderate run at Navan, fair sixth over C&D last month

runners.name: Lucy's Promise
runners.spotlight: Did not show much on first two starts; took a step in the right direction when a staying-on sixth of 17 at Navan; may uphold the form of that race with I Ready; interesting.
runners.comment: Took a step in the right direction when a staying-on sixth of 17 at Navan, interesting

runners.name: Seven Nation Army
runners.spotlight: Given three runs in nine days in May to get a mark; none of his efforts was particularly notable, but he has been gelded since and brings an intriguing profile to his first handicap, bearing in mind that his trainer has so much trial material in this age group.
runners.comment: Three runs in nine days in May to get a mark, gelded since, intriguing profile

races.race_name: Final Furlong Podcast With 1xBet.ie Irish EBF Maiden

runners.name: Pierre Grosse
runners.spotlight: Sets the standard on 83 after seven runs; one of his best efforts came in a Down Royal handicap last time (1m5f, soft) when headed late on into second; a repeat of that could see him go close.
runners.comment: Sets standard off 83; one of best efforts came when second in h'cap last time; chance

runners.name: Abbotsford
runners.spotlight: Frankel gelding ran poorly on debut at Dundalk when missing the break (1m); much better at Cork (10.5f, soft) on seasonal return when showing signs of greenness but just denied by a head; gelded since then and heads the list of likely candidates.
runners.comment: Frankel gelding was denied by a head on seasonal return at Cork; heads shortlist

runners.name: Sakoku
runners.spotlight: Took a huge step forward from her 1m2f debut here when upped to 1m5f at Leopardstown (good to firm) in a newly-added tongue tie, headed into second in the dying strides; benefitted from being ridden positively that day and should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Huge step forward on her second start when second over 1m5f; thereabouts

runners.name: Numantia
runners.spotlight: Both runs to date came over 1m2f here; was an eyecatcher on debut (good) when keeping on for a 1.75l fourth; nothing went right for him last time when slowly away, racing wide and hitting the front too early, but was still a creditable second; step up in trip should suit and he's very interesting with some better luck.
runners.comment: Nothing went right for him last time when second; interesting with better luck

runners.name: Solness
runners.spotlight: Three-time Grade 1-winning chaser makes his Flat debut here at the age of eight; his dam is an unraced half-sister to a German 1m Listed winner; it's hard to know what to expect from him, but he's an intriguing runner and hails from a savvy yard in great form.
runners.comment: Three-time Gr.1 winning chaser makes Flat debut; intriguing runner

runners.name: Tokyo Tower
runners.spotlight: Creditable first run over 1m2f here last month when outpaced late on but taking sixth of 11 (good to firm, 100-30); not unfancied that day; needs a bit more.
runners.comment: Not unfancied and ran creditably in his first run here when sixth; needs a bit more

runners.name: Teoest
runners.spotlight: Distant fourth behind a runaway winner on debut at Dundalk in May (winner subsequently placed in a Royal Ascot handicap); was 1.25l behind the third horse, who won easily next time; could outrun his likely odds.
runners.comment: Distant fourth behind easy winner on debut; third horse won next time; could outrun odds

races.race_name: Sharon Pardy 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Edelak
runners.spotlight: Won three consecutive times (once over C&D) in May/June and held good lead before falling at third-last flight in recent 2m2f handicap here; leading contender back in novice company.
runners.comment: Won three in a row in May/June and was in front when falling here last week

runners.name: Obsessedwithyou
runners.spotlight: Returned from break in career-best form over fences this spring and subsequently exploited her novice hurdle status at Hexham (2m, good), albeit unimpressive in justifying skinny odds; suited by fast ground and features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: In career-best form over fences this spring and exploited novice hurdle status last month
runners.owner: Awr Consultancy Ltd & The Folly Partners

runners.name: He's Tailor Made
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced in the second of his two bumpers last season but tailed off when switched to hurdling this month; tongue-tie now added.
runners.comment: Tailed off when switched to hurdling this month; tongue-tie now added

runners.name: Angel Of My Dreams
runners.spotlight: Well beaten here on both recent hurdling starts (2m2f/2m), the latter after a wind op; can't be recommended.
runners.comment: Well beaten here on both recent hurdling starts (2m2f/2m)

races.race_name: George & Dragon Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Duel Au Soleil
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles last season and made pretty good start to chasing career when third of seven at Bangor (2m4f, good; wore cheekpieces) in April; weakened out of contention on run-in at Worcester (2m7f, good; first-time visor) this month but drops back in trip here and remains of interest.
runners.comment: Ran well over 2m4f on chase debut; back in trip after weakening over 2m7f this month

runners.name: Mary
runners.spotlight: Both wins over hurdles when making all, one here on fast ground; ridden with more restraint since returning this year but was in contention before last-fence fall at Bangor (2m4f, good) two starts ago, and last month's Uttoxeter third was respectable; can go well again and it will be interesting to see whether she reverts to more positive tactics.
runners.comment: Course winner over hurdles and in good form over fences lately; considered

runners.name: Whatyouwaitingfor
runners.spotlight: 0-4 over fences for new stable this year but ran well over 2m1f here on last two appearances, losing out only by half a length on latter occasion; should be fine over this longer trip; good chance.
runners.comment: Ran well over 2m1f here on last two outings and should be fine over this longer trip

runners.name: The Long Walk
runners.spotlight: 1-9 over hurdles; makes chasing debut from a workable mark but has become very inconsistent and was well beaten in first-time cheekpieces last month (2m7f); drops back in trip with visor tried here; not easy to predict.
runners.comment: Makes chase debut from workable mark but far too inconsistent to rely upon; new headgear

runners.name: Hooper
runners.spotlight: Well suited by this track when a useful hurdler for Nicky Henderson a few years ago but, following a long absence, has been safely held on both starts for new stable this season, latterly back here in a three-runner race; needs a revival on first chasing attempt since 2022.
runners.comment: Well suited by this track but has regressed; first chasing attempt since 2022

races.race_name: Dave Shrader Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Stellarmasterpiece
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat-racer who returned to hurdling with two fast-ground course wins (2m/2m2f) this season; drew nicely clear on run-in on latter occasion and commands respect in current mood.
runners.comment: Drew nicely clear on run-in here last month and now bids for a course hat-trick

runners.name: Northern Rose
runners.spotlight: 0-25 over hurdles but has run some good races at this track, most recently when close second over 2m (good to firm) three weeks ago; also suited by this longer trip and can make her presence felt again.
runners.comment: 0-25 over hurdles but has run some good races at this track, the latest last month

runners.name: Kotgar
runners.spotlight: Safely held when fifth in first-time cheekpieces here (2m, good) last month and now 0-10 over hurdles; upped in trip and tried in a visor today; improvement required.
runners.comment: Safely held in cheekpieces here last month; now 0-10 over hurdles; visor tried today

runners.name: Get A Superstar
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner (2m5f/2m3f) this spring, after a break; didn't see out 3m on latest outing but drops back in trip for this switch back to hurdling and his current mark is workable; respected.
runners.comment: In good form over fences this season and reverts to hurdling on a workable mark

runners.name: Mystic Wind
runners.spotlight: Held up in rear and showed nothing more than glimmers of promise in three 2m maiden/novice hurdles this spring but has a tongue-tie fitted and moves up in trip for this handicap debut; improvement possible.
runners.comment: Did not show a great deal in his qualifying races but open to improvement in handicaps

runners.name: Hopjes
runners.spotlight: Unexposed over hurdles after only five runs but was beaten about 23l when seventh of 12 here (2m, good) on last month's handicap debut and is effectively 4lb higher today.
runners.comment: Safely held here on last month's handicap debut and effectively 4lb higher today

runners.name: Ghost Pepper
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all eight hurdling starts for David Jeffreys and absent since pulled up over 3m in November; 3lb out of the weights for this stable debut and could be considered only if lively in the betting.
runners.comment: Unplaced all eight hurdle runs for previous stable and absent since pulled up in autumn

races.race_name: Patrick's 60th Celebration Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Charging Thunder
runners.spotlight: Not at best on the Flat this year (albeit still capable of useful form) and managed only fourth of six when warm favourite for latest hurdle race, at Worcester (2m, good) in May; that said, he's a stout stayer on the Flat and could have untapped potential over this new trip over jumps.
runners.comment: Only fourth of six on latest hurdling start (2m) but looks interesting over this new trip

runners.name: Campaign Trail
runners.spotlight: Flopped badly when favourite at Hexham last month and needs to put that behind him but looked in good nick when making all for clearcut success at Hereford (3m1f, good) two runs ago; dangerous if back at that level.
runners.comment: Not himself on latest outing but a danger to all if judged on earlier Hereford win

runners.name: Lion Of The Desert
runners.spotlight: Improving 6yo who kept on resolutely to score over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago and has now won three times since the spring; another 5lb higher now but a likely contender again.
runners.comment: Kept on resolutely over C&D last month and has now won three times since the spring

runners.name: Parikarma
runners.spotlight: Slightly disappointing at Perth last week but was placed on consecutive outings beforehand, once over C&D on fast ground; swaps blinkers for refitted visor (worn once on Flat in 2020); no surprise if she's on the premises.
runners.comment: Not at best last week but placed twice (once over C&D) beforehand; enters calculations

runners.name: Hillview
runners.spotlight: Regressive 10yo who has been lightly raced in recent years and returned from a break with two low-key runs this spring; pulled up (lost action) in first-time cheekpieces (retained) recently; revival needed.
runners.comment: Regressive 10yo; lightly raced in recent years and needs a revival

races.race_name: Silver Fox Classic Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Captain Cool
runners.spotlight: Progressive 6yo with 3-4 strike-rate over fences, including two fast-ground C&D wins this season; the form of last month's 20l success in a three-runner race is tricky to evaluate (odds-on favourite below par) but a 4lb rise could have been worse and he may still be on the upgrade.
runners.comment: Progressive 6yo with 3-4 strike-rate over fences, including two C&D wins this season

runners.name: In The Air
runners.spotlight: Back in prime form when holding on well to score over C&D (good) on last month's chase return and now 4-10 over fences; recent 3lb rise does not look excessive and there's a good chance he'll be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Back in prime form over C&D last month and now 4-10 over fences; 3b rise not excessive

runners.name: Breaking Cover
runners.spotlight: 3-10 over fences, the latest win gained at Newton Abbot (2m, good to soft) last autumn; returned from break with respectable fourth (a nose behind Sir Tivo) in race fought out by two progressive rivals at Uttoxeter (2m, good) last month and has a big role to play if that outing brought him on.
runners.comment: Triple chase winner in 2025; made encouraging reappearance last month; big player

runners.name: Centara
runners.spotlight: Free-going front-runner who won five 2m chases in early part of last season; comfortably reeled in on both outings since returning from a break this spring, though, and comes here with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Free-going front-runner; five wins in 2025; comfortably reeled in both outings this season

runners.name: Sir Tivo
runners.spotlight: Veteran with 11 chase wins on his CV, including 2023 edition of this race; returns here after respectable third behind two progressive rivals at Uttoxeter (2m, good) last month but Centara is unlikely to allow him to play his preferred front-running role.
runners.comment: 11 chase wins, including this race in 2023; ran okay last time; easy lead unlikely here

races.race_name: PJ McGeever 70th Birthday Celebration Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Artiste d'Ainay
runners.spotlight: Won a point in the spring and is 2-4 since returned to racing under rules for new stable, the latter win gained off today's mark on chasing debut here (2m6f, good to firm) a week ago; likes to make the running, and could be hard to catch on this quick return to hurdling.
runners.comment: Won here off today's mark on chase debut a week ago; now 2-4 for stable; good chance

runners.name: He Is A Cracker
runners.spotlight: Has mixed record for this stable since last autumn but returned from break to cause 25-1 surprise over fences at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) this month and is now 2-6 for the yard; it's hard to predict whether he'll be in the right mood again here but he has a lower mark over hurdles.
runners.comment: Hard to predict but caused 25-1 surprise over fences this month and has lower hurdle mark

runners.name: East Eagle
runners.spotlight: Drew clear to clear by 9l over C&D (good) in April, his third hurdling success, and is now only 2lb above that mark but looked out of sorts on his latest outing and is not one to rely upon heavily.
runners.comment: Good C&D winner in April but out of sorts last time and not one to rely upon
runners.owner: Mrs Janet Cooper & M E Sowersby

runners.name: Luna Run
runners.spotlight: Safely held when odds-on for stable debut at Warwick (2m5f) in May but, with a tongue-tie fitted, made amends over 3m2f there (also on good) last month; came clear of the others with a progressive rival that day and could still be well handicapped after 5lb rise.
runners.comment: Came good for stable at second attempt and could still be well handicapped after 5lb rise

races.race_name: Grace And Dotty Conditional Jockeys' Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Roarin' Success
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat in her prime and came good over hurdles at fifth attempt, battling well for narrow course win (2m, good to firm; first-time tongue-tie) three weeks ago; open to further progress if stamina holds out over this new trip; respected.
runners.comment: Battled well for narrow 2m course win last month and still lightly raced over hurdles
runners.owner: Hale Racing, Lyle Farming Company & Ptnr

runners.name: Lucy The Wire
runners.spotlight: Below form when eighth behind Roarin' Success here last month but won readily in first-time cheekpieces at Worcester (2m, good) nine days ago and now 2-7 over hurdles; moves up in trip; big player if new headgear continues to aid.
runners.comment: Won readily in new cheekpieces nine days ago and now 2-7 over hurdles

runners.name: Basilette
runners.spotlight: Runs this track well and posted career-best hurdling performance when scoring over C&D (good to firm) a week ago; 7lb penalty gives her a big weight to carry today but, nevertheless, she has strong claims.
runners.comment: Posted career-best hurdling performance when scoring over C&D  a week ago; 7lb penalty.

runners.name: Klervia
runners.spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles; two of this year's six runs for Fergal O'Brien offered significant hope but she was soundly beaten on her latest outing; now back in the care of Barry Brennan; others have much less to prove.
runners.comment: 0-10 over hurdles; back with Barry Brennan after heavy defeat for Fergal O'Brien in June

runners.name: Dusky Spyglass
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 8yo who struggled when 200-1 for handicap debut at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) in March; big leap of faith required to support her.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 8yo who struggled when 200-1 for handicap debut in March

races.race_name: Racing TV Free Trial EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Hey Up Ronnie
runners.spotlight: Met traffic en route to a promising fifth of 15, best of the newcomers, in the long-established Rous Selling Stakes at York (6f, good); shaped as if 7f will suit; the form pick.
runners.comment: Promising fifth of 15 in the long-established Rous Selling Stakes at York; the form pick

runners.name: Mojito Madness
runners.spotlight: Needed the outing/experience on debut; fared better, despite a tardy start, at Epsom (7f, good) where he stayed on for third of eight; respected with another step forward plausible.
runners.comment: Stayed on for third of eight at Epsom last time; open to further progress; respected

runners.name: Bonjour Belle
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise with fifth of 11 in Chester seller (7f, good to soft); posted a lesser effort on AW later in June but may be capable of improvement returned to turf.
runners.comment: Showed some promise in Chester seller; lesser effort on AW later in June

runners.name: Gerry's Darling
runners.spotlight: Not particularly solid on her Doncaster efforts (7f) having finished eighth of 13 then last of seven; however, this is probably an easier assignment; may raise her game.
runners.comment: Not solid on her Doncaster efforts but this is probably an easier assignment

runners.name: Tommo's Queen
runners.spotlight: 4,000gns yearling; by Cracksman out of once-raced sister to winners Pelerin (7f/1m Listed) and Base Note (smart 9.7f-1m4f); yard is only 1-28 with 2yos this term.
runners.comment: 4,000gns yearling; by Cracksman; yard is only 1-28 with 2yos this term

runners.name: Kompozitor
runners.spotlight: 6,000gns yearling; by Sergei Prokofiev and first foal of 1m2f AW scorer (RPR 62); stable had a winning 2yo newcomer (SP 28-1) at Redcar last month; one to bear in mind.
runners.comment: 6,000gns yearling; stable had a winning 2yo newcomer at Redcar last month
runners.owner: Mrs D Dalby And J Knotts

runners.name: Nosey Book
runners.spotlight: Belardo half-brother to winners Daydreama (6f 2yo, for Tim Easterby; RPR 92) and Tuddenham Green (2m hurdle); dam 2m AW scorer (58); check the market signals.
runners.comment: Siblings include a 6f 2yo winner for his yard; check the market signals

runners.name: Be More Ruthless
runners.spotlight: Always behind in 7f maiden at Carlisle, beating just one rival in a field of 11; seems one for handicaps later on.
runners.comment: Always behind in 7f maiden at Carlisle

runners.name: Coul Blue
runners.spotlight: £16,000 yearling; Gregorian half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Magistery (RPR 67), out of 7f scorer (including 2yo; 95); suitably bred; market support would heighten interest.
runners.comment: £16,000 yearling; Gregorian half-brother to a 6f 2yo winner; check the betting
runners.owner: Mrs T Burns And Rjh Ltd

runners.name: Bollin Marsha
runners.spotlight: From a family that her trainer knows well; however, her form suggests nurseries will be much more suitable shortly.
runners.comment: Form suggests nurseries will be more suitable shortly
runners.owner: D B & Mrs C Lamplough & Partner

runners.name: Hicko's Lad
runners.spotlight: Holds weak form claims, having finished last in both starts, latest in seven-runner maiden over C&D.
runners.comment: Has finished last in both starts, latest over C&D

runners.name: Bedwyr
runners.spotlight: Trailed home last of ten in 7f AW maiden at Newcastle having blown the start; needs to break much better and take a huge step forward.
runners.comment: Trailed home last in 7f AW maiden having blown the start

runners.name: Dave's Matey
runners.spotlight: Needs big improvement for a physical tweak, namely the gelding operation he's undergone since posting two duck eggs in May.
runners.comment: Gelded since posting two duck eggs in May

runners.name: Thai Paddy
runners.spotlight: Finished last of ten in 7f event at Ayr; needs to leave that form well behind and is a similar type to Bedwyr.
runners.comment: Finished last of ten in 7f event at Ayr

races.race_name: Luke Jobson Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Indefensible
runners.spotlight: Capable of fair form but not proving the easiest to catch right; one of his better efforts when third of nine in 7f Catterick handicap 11 days ago; however, only third of four when favourite for 6f maiden at Ripon on Saturday.
runners.comment: Good third at Catterick on penultimate start; beaten favourite in 6f maiden yesterday

runners.name: Derrygarran Lad
runners.spotlight: Son of Persian King who has shaped well to be placed on both his runs, a clear second of nine in 1m novice at Newcastle in February; off since but he remains with potential and merits serious consideration.
runners.comment: Shaped well with clear Newcastle second in February; remains with potential and big player

runners.name: Ben Travato
runners.spotlight: 1,000euros yearling; Galileo Gold gelding; half-brother to winners Philos (1m4f/1m6f; RPR 67) and Cham's Pride (Spanish 9.5f); dam, French 9.5f turf/10.7f AW winner, is a sister to 1m Listed winner Toungi; hooded for his debut and the market can guide.
runners.comment: Galileo Gold gelding; hooded for his debut and the market can guide

runners.name: Triple P
runners.spotlight: 5,000gns yearling; closely related to 5f AW winner Traditionelle (RPR 73) and a half-brother to seven other winners, notably Universal Gleam (1m-1m2f; RPR 99) and Fools And Kings (9.4f AW/1m4f turf; RPR 89); dam 5f winner (RPR 80); the betting can prove an accurate indicator for this Mattmu gelding on his first run.
runners.comment: The betting can prove an accurate indicator for this Mattmu gelding on his first run

runners.name: Twilight Baby
runners.spotlight: Well held in 7f Musselburgh maiden in November and 7f Southwell novice on her return two weeks ago; significantly more is required.
runners.comment: Well held both runs, in Southwell novice on her return two weeks ago

runners.name: Feliz Navidad
runners.spotlight: 18-1, well-held fifth of six in maiden at Beverley (8.4f, good) on his debut last month; this son of Mondialiste needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Well-held fifth of six at Beverley on his debut; needs to take a big step forward

races.race_name: racingtv.com/freetrial Handicap

runners.name: Billy Bathgate
runners.spotlight: A four-time scorer (including here in 2025); in good nick without winning this season, finding drop to 1m4f against him when a staying-on sixth of 12 at Newcastle last time; this veteran needs considering back up in trip.
runners.comment: In good nick without winning this season; this course winner needs considering

runners.name: Lillistar
runners.spotlight: Winless since a breakthrough victory at Wolverhampton (2m) in October but she got back on song with third of five in 2m Catterick handicap in May; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Winless since October but back on song with third at Catterick in May; not ruled out

runners.name: Sweet Cicely
runners.spotlight: Is 0-22 and she came in last of six in 1m4f handicap at Beverley 26 days ago; has her stamina to prove here too.
runners.comment: Is 0-22 and she came in last of six at Beverley 26 days ago; has stamina to prove too

runners.name: Stitching Wheel
runners.spotlight: Ex-French filly who capitalised on a reduced mark when gaining a first win at the 14th attempt in 1m6f handicap here last month; back up 4lb but another bold showing is on the cards with this return to 2m a likely plus.
runners.comment: Gained first win here last month; bold showing on cards with return to 2m a likely plus

races.race_name: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap

runners.name: Rajapour
runners.spotlight: It's now 13 starts since his last success but he comes here in good form, challenging wide when fourth of nine in 1m handicap at Pontefract 12 days ago; weighted to go well eased 1lb.
runners.comment: On losing run but in good form, fourth at Pontefract latest; weighted to go well eased 1lb

runners.name: Nyman
runners.spotlight: Signed off for 2025 at Newmarket (7f) in November and in good nick this season until coming in last of six over C&D in May; the sort to bounce back after a break.
runners.comment: In good nick this season until last of six over C&D in May; sort to bounce back

runners.name: Titainium
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 out of sorts after 1m2f Wetherby success last June; off 11 months before coming in a well-held eighth of 11 in 1m1f Carlisle handicap on his return last month; this course scorer needs to take a major step forward.
runners.comment: Course winner; off 11 months before well-held Carlisle eighth on return; lots more needed

runners.name: Criminal Shore
runners.spotlight: Ended a long losing run at Newcastle (1m) in June but only 17th in 7f York handicap since; he needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Ended a long losing run at Newcastle (1m) in June but only 17th in 7f York handicap since

runners.name: Amidst The Chaos
runners.spotlight: Headstrong sort but he's taken his form up a notch since cheekpieces went on, scoring at Pontefract (1m) in June before beaten a nose when a clear second at Doncaster (1m) since having hung badly left in front; not the easiest of rides but a player once more here.
runners.comment: Scored at Pontefract before beaten a nose at Doncaster having hung left in front; player

runners.name: Yafaarr
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways over C&D in June and backed it up with a solid third of eight at Doncaster (1m) 16 days ago; ought to be thereabouts again.
runners.comment: Won over C&D and posted a solid third at Doncaster since; ought to be thereabouts again

runners.name: Bowood
runners.spotlight: A two-time 1m scorer at Newcastle last autumn; yet to hit top form this season though, only seventh of 14 back over 1m there last month; mark is slipping but he still needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: Yet to hit top form this term, seventh at Newcastle latest; needs to take a step forward

races.race_name: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Be Patient
runners.spotlight: Comfortably prevailed in Doncaster handicap (1m2f, good to firm) on seasonal debut, following up his autumn AW success (1m, AW) and taking record to 2-3; the only unexposed contender in this field and commands respect with further improvement on the cards.
runners.comment: Scored comfortably at Doncaster on reappearance, taking record to 2-3; respected

runners.name: Financer
runners.spotlight: Scored three times, including over C&D, in 2024; has built up a long losing sequence since but is an in-form contender, half-length second when favourite at Carlisle most recently; on an attractive mark and Jake Dickson takes off a bonus 7lb; possibilities.
runners.comment: On a long losing sequence but is an in-form contender and on an attractive mark
runners.owner: S Bulmer, P Hebdon & R Taylor

runners.name: Blue To Blue
runners.spotlight: Scored three times (5f/7f) last term for previous yard; inconsistent over 1m this season and failed to beat a rival last time but best form gives him a fighting chance off current mark; continues to steadily rise in distance and now has a crack at 1m2f.
runners.comment: Inconsistent this term but best form gives him a fighting chance; new trip

runners.name: Nepal
runners.spotlight: Successful in Britain and Bahrain during his spell with George Scott; gave impression something was amiss when last seen (had wind surgery since); current mark, combined with carrying a big weight, makes this his stiffest handicap assignment.
runners.comment: Current mark makes this his stiffest handicap assignment; debut for new yard

races.race_name: Try Racing TV For Free Now Handicap

runners.name: Baldosa
runners.spotlight: Has found some consistency (form figures 241) since upped to 1m2f; opened her account in Nottingham event (good to firm) most recently; solid contender off only 2lb higher kept to this distance.
runners.comment: Has found some consistency (form figures 241) since upped to 1m2f; solid claims

runners.name: Harswell River
runners.spotlight: Record is only 1-21 but her record at Redcar includes the sole win and three placed efforts; possibilities off current mark, provided she's in top form and stays this new trip.
runners.comment: Record is only 1-21 but she's suited by Redcar and on a workable mark; new trip

runners.name: Diamond Aura
runners.spotlight: Has been moving in the right direction switched to turf this term and finished a good second at Leicester (1m2f) most recently; sold out of Hugo Palmer's yard for 12,000gns since; turn may be near.
runners.comment: Good second at Leicester last time (final start for Hugo Palmer); turn may be near

runners.name: Sahm Naif
runners.spotlight: Held on narrowly at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) last time, opening his account at the fifth attempt; may build on that win and improve further, provided he takes to first-time headgear; shortlisted.
runners.comment: May build on Beverley win and improve further, provided he takes to headgear

runners.name: Skirt Around
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who has failed to beat a rival in two handicaps this term, running below her 2yo form; chance depends on the effects of first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Chance depends on the effects of first-time headgear

runners.name: Bobbys Pride
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who has achieved little; goes beyond 1m for the first time.
runners.comment: Has achieved little; goes beyond 1m for first time

runners.name: Secret Testimony
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent sort who has been campaigned mostly over 7f, winning once (on AW); only a modest fourth at Redcar most recently; enough to prove back up in distance.
runners.comment: Inconsistent sort who gained sole win over 7f on AW; enough to prove

runners.name: Speckled Brown
runners.spotlight: Not particularly solid on form but she is the sole handicap newcomer in this field and may be capable of improvement; steps up in distance; market support should be noted.
runners.comment: The sole handicap newcomer in this field and may be capable of improvement

runners.name: Talking In Kode
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; has shown bits of promise, including in first-time cheekpieces at Nottingham (upped to 1m2f) most recently; may build on that effort, kept to same trip in the retained headgear.
runners.comment: Has shown bits of promise, including with cheekpieces fitted last time

races.race_name: Start Your Racing TV Free Trial Handicap

runners.name: Off Spin
runners.spotlight: Is 0-17 but he arrives in good form, placed for third consecutive start when runner-up in 1m2f Ayr handicap (Shifter third) two weeks ago; 1lb worse off with that rival here but he can go very well again.
runners.comment: Is 0-17 but arrives in good form, runner-up at Ayr latest; can go very well off same mark
runners.owner: S Bulmer, P Hebdon & R Taylor

runners.name: Shifter
runners.spotlight: Two-time course scorer who came in a close third at Ayr (Off Spin in second) before extending her run of good efforts with a close fifth of 12 in 1m2f handicap there 13 days ago; a player once more eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Two-time course scorer; good fifth at Ayr 13 days ago; a player once more eased 1lb

runners.name: Volenti
runners.spotlight: Arrives in decent nick without winning, fourth of nine in 1m handicap at Ripon 13 days ago; it's now 20 runs since his last victory however.
runners.comment: Arrives in decent nick without winning; it's now 20 runs since his last victory however

runners.name: Pebble Dash
runners.spotlight: Is 0-17 and he failed to build on earlier promise with sixth of eight in 7f classified event at Ayr last month; others are preferred.
runners.comment: Is 0-17 and failed to build on earlier promise with Ayr sixth latest; others preferred

runners.name: Pisanello
runners.spotlight: On a long losing sequence and he was tried without usual cheekpieces when beating just two in 1m2f Leicester handicap 24 days ago; visor is tried again now but others still appeal more.
runners.comment: On a long losing sequence and beat two at Leicester latest; visor is tried again now

runners.name: Bitacora
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish mare who gained a first win for Daragh Bourke in classified event at Wolverhampton (8.5f) last March; lightly raced since and only ninth of 14 in 1m Newcastle handicap in April; since had a wind op (tongue-strap also goes back on) so can't be discounted after a break.
runners.comment: Below-par ninth at Newcastle in April; had wind op so not discounted after a break

runners.name: Anificas Beauty
runners.spotlight: Bagged a pair of 8.5f Beverley handicaps this summer but she ran poorly in her hat-trick bid at Pontefract (1m) last time; she's the sort to bounce back though.
runners.comment: Won twice at Beverley but poor run at Pontefract latest; the sort to bounce back though

runners.name: Finally Escaped
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Newcastle on her debut and in decent nick since sent handicapping, most recently prevailing at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm; well on top at the finish) two days ago when back from a layoff; may build on that win and improve further; respected under 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Well on top at the finish at Nottingham on Friday when back from layoff; respected

races.race_name: John Bircham And Stephen "Jagger" Hayes Memorial Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: High Aura
runners.spotlight: Beaten a little under 8l on debut at Stratford where she got pestered up front and weakened; the second has won again since and this looks weaker.
runners.comment: Third at Stratford; the second has won again since and this looks weaker

runners.name: Us Officer
runners.spotlight: One competitive run in six Flat starts, though finished tailed off in his only run this year (1m2f) after being gelded; goes hurdling in a weak race but with enough to prove.
runners.comment: One competitive run in six Flat starts; goes hurdling in a weak race

runners.name: Hearts To Heaven
runners.spotlight: Dam unraced sister to useful bumper/2m4f hurdle winner Tikkanbar; best watch on debut.
runners.comment: Debutante; dam unraced sister to useful bumper/2m4f hurdle winner Tikkanbar

runners.name: Timely Salute
runners.spotlight: 0-6 for William Knight, though latest fourth at Lingfield (extended 1m3f) was one of his better efforts; new trainer, whom he joined for 10,500gns, goes with a hood for hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Showed a bit of ability in six Flat defeats but ended up with a very modest mark

runners.name: My Champion
runners.spotlight: AW winner over 8.6f for Ed Bethell, his only success in eight starts; didn't exactly sign off for that yard in great form and was sold on for 1,500gns.
runners.comment: AW winner for Ed Bethell but left that yard for 1,500gns

races.race_name: Happy 80th Birthday Ted Hull Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Getmyfriend
runners.spotlight: Won a Southwell bumper on good ground in May but beaten a fair way since, including on hurdle debut here; still rates a likely contender if tapping back into the promise of her win.
runners.comment: Beaten 16l on hurdle debut but she's a bumper winner who should be capable of better

runners.name: Diamond White
runners.spotlight: Promise in bumpers and again when runner-up to a useful odds-on winner in a Worcester maiden; should be on the scene.
runners.comment: Runner-up to a useful odds-on winner in a Worcester maiden; should be on the scene

runners.name: Take The Boat
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat racer at up to 1m6f with 4-22 strike-rate; close second on hurdle debut at Stratford (good to firm) before finishing a well-held third behind a classy sort back there a month ago; can go well.
runners.comment: Four Flat wins; positive hurdle debut and latest race was won by a classy sort
runners.owner: Posh Pundit Racing Club & G Nicholls

runners.name: Crystal Jet
runners.spotlight: Won her third bumper start (good ground) but was beaten 16l into fourth on her hurdle debut and since then has finished out the back in a 1m6f maiden at Goodwood; has ability though and this isn't a good maiden.
runners.comment: Bumper winner; beaten 16l on hurdle debut; not without hope if building on that

runners.name: Arfursgal
runners.spotlight: Essentially disappointing since finishing second in her first bumper at Newbury (soft) and was beaten miles behind a stablemate on hurdle debut at Plumpton (2m4f, good).
runners.comment: Essentially disappointing since finishing second in her first bumper at Newbury

runners.name: Steal A Glance
runners.spotlight: Low-level bumper form even when she was placed; well behind Getmyfriend here 16 days ago.
runners.comment: Low-level bumper form even when she was placed; well behind Getmyfriend here 16 days ago

runners.name: Ask Peter
runners.spotlight: 1m4f/1m6f wins for Charlie Johnston; now 0-11 over hurdles and was disappointing in a low-grade handicap here only recently; however, there is placed form in her record and she could have some part to play.
runners.comment: 1m4f/1m6f wins for Charlie Johnston; now 0-11 over hurdles but with placed form

runners.name: Lundy View
runners.spotlight: Not a lot to show for two bumper runs and was 125-1 when tailed off on hurdle debut here.
runners.comment: Not a lot to show for two bumper runs and was 125-1 when tailed off on hurdle debut here

races.race_name: Dick Oliver At Newton Abbot Races Handicap Chase

runners.name: The Gypsy Davey
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner from 20 attempts over fences; returned to form when second to It's A Breeze here last week where he wasn't unlucky despite some late interference; should run well with a repeat, but can be inconsistent.
runners.comment: Returned to form when second to It's A Breeze here last week; can be inconsistent

runners.name: Watchoutitscookie
runners.spotlight: 1-12 as a chaser; good and bad in his last six races over hurdles, finishing tailed off in the last two; risky.
runners.comment: 1-12 as a chaser; good and bad in his last six races over hurdles

runners.name: It's A Breeze
runners.spotlight: 0-9 as a hurdler but only his fourth run over fences when making light work of The Gypsy Davey over C&D (add 23yds) six days ago; penalised accordingly but Paddy Hanlon's claim takes care of 5lb of that.
runners.comment: Easy C&D winner last week; Paddy Hanlon's claim takes care of 5lb of the penalty

runners.name: Chief Black Robe
runners.spotlight: 10yo who has come a long way down the weights and he's had a sticky period since finishing second at Market Rasen five runs back; however, coming back from 3m could be a good move.
runners.comment: He's had a sticky period since finishing second at Market Rasen five runs back

runners.name: Emberscombe
runners.spotlight: Record of 4-8 in points but 16 defeats under rules include eight chases; ran no race last time and she's 2lb wrong.
runners.comment: 16 defeats under rules include eight chases; ran no race last time and she's 2lb wrong

runners.name: Senor Diaz
runners.spotlight: No wins in 14; ran better in his third chase over C&D in May, beaten about 13l behind one having a good summer; 2lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Fair third here last time, beaten about 13l behind one having a good summer

runners.name: Chillhi
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of racing under both codes and has been regressing for a while now; chase debut.
runners.comment: Had plenty of racing under both codes and has been regressing for a while now; chase debut

runners.name: Flashy Boy
runners.spotlight: Limited hurdler who was pulled up on chase debut in January; subsequent pointing exploits aren't overly compelling.
runners.comment: Pulled up in previous chase and subsequent pointing exploits aren't overly compelling

races.race_name: Brendon Soper Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Linden Lane
runners.spotlight: 0-14; close third over 2m1f here in June and wasn't beaten that far on his return visit; could be a factor.
runners.comment: Close third over 2m1f here in June and wasn't beaten that far on his return visit

runners.name: Son Of Hypnos
runners.spotlight: All downhill since winning over hurdles at Galway's festival of 2024; well beaten in three of his four runs for this yard and when third in April only five ran; visor added.
runners.comment: All downhill since winning over hurdles at Galway's festival of 2024

runners.name: Makinbecon
runners.spotlight: Behind Man Oh Man here two runs ago but a winner on either side of that, latterly by a length in this new headgear combination; up another 5lb but he's running well.
runners.comment: Behind Man Oh Man here two runs ago but a winner on either side of that

runners.name: Saucats
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 25th attempt with a comfortable C&D success this month and similar form in defeat last week off this 3lb higher mark; in the mix.
runners.comment: Recent C&D winner and similar effort in defeat last week off this 3lb higher mark

runners.name: Man Oh Man
runners.spotlight: Very mixed this year but, with the tongue-tie removed, he went down by a whisker over C&D last month having travelled best; 4lb higher; chance.
runners.comment: He went down by a whisker over C&D last month having travelled best

runners.name: Mi Sueno
runners.spotlight: Hard to win with but he's on a competitive mark if new trainer Nick Scholfield can get him back on track; market helpful.
runners.comment: Competitive mark if new trainer Nick Scholfield can get him back on track; market helpful

runners.name: Yanka Blue
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden; wasn't in much form until last week's keeping-on second at Stratford and that effort brings her into it.
runners.comment: Still a maiden; wasn't in much form until last week's keeping-on second at Stratford

runners.name: Applejack Poet
runners.spotlight: Has a modest strike rate of 1-31 under rules; positive start for this yard when third over hurdles last month but not great since, last week on his return to fences.
runners.comment: Beaten 17l over fences here last week; has a modest strike rate of 1-31 under rules

races.race_name: Zero To Exit Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Juggernaut
runners.spotlight: Consistent 7yo but not well handicapped and again came up short when third over Fontwell's extended 3m1f when last seen; James Robottom has claimed his 10lb on this gelding's last three starts.
runners.comment: Consistent 7yo but not well handicapped and continues to come up short

runners.name: Byzantium
runners.spotlight: 2m3f/2m5f winner last summer on good ground; he was in lead when he ran out before second-last at Wincanton (3m, good) but followed that a very underwhelming effort; some reservations for now but the ability is there to get involved.
runners.comment: Ran out two starts back and then produced a very underwhelming effort

runners.name: I Am Spider Man
runners.spotlight: Only 3-33 and without a win since 2024; however, arrives here on the back of some solid efforts in defeat, even last time when seventh.
runners.comment: No win since 2024 but arrives here on the back of some solid efforts in defeat

runners.name: Jager Time
runners.spotlight: 3m1f winner who has been running well for a while and would have prevailed in another stride over C&D a month ago; up 4lb so has another career-high mark to deal with, but clear claims.
runners.comment: Would have prevailed in another stride over C&D a month ago; up 4lb

runners.name: Time To Bite
runners.spotlight: Better chaser than hurdler and forgiven latest heavy defeat in a strong handicap; his last hurdle run was four starts back when beaten a neck at Wincanton (2m5f, good); could run well, though some stamina reservations over quite this far.
runners.comment: Better chaser than hurdler but went close on final hurdle run four starts back

runners.name: Stavanger Rose
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; 50-1 when tailed off on handicap debut last time over 2m4f.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden; 50-1 when tailed off on handicap debut last time over 2m4f

races.race_name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Chase

runners.name: No More No
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and he's 2-2 over fences, at Southwell 40 days ago (about 3m1f) defying a 13lb rise and a 393-day absence with a narrow verdict; if he can back that up then a 3lb nudge shouldn't be beyond him.
runners.comment: Back from another absence for a hard-fought win at Southwell; raised 3lb

runners.name: Honey I'm Good
runners.spotlight: The last of four chase wins was in August 2024; she's building some momentum after a long absence having pushed Edgewell close over C&D a month ago; that was under a 10lb claimer but she has to be considered.
runners.comment: Three runs back from a long absence and pushed Edgewell close in the latest

runners.name: My Girl Katie
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last summer at the expense of Testflight who beat her next time in this race; another win on fast ground at Stratford soon after before a 20l defeat here; high in the weights now and she's been absent 11 months.
runners.comment: C&D winner but high in the weights now and she's been absent 11 months

runners.name: Testflight
runners.spotlight: Sole career success came in this race 12 months ago and a recent close fourth here behind Edgewell should have teed him up for his defence; nothing wrong with his mark for all that he's 1lb wrong.
runners.comment: Last year's winner on a good mark; encouraging run behind Edgewell last time

runners.name: Mcgregors Charge
runners.spotlight: 1-12 over fences; below par for a while now, including on recent stable debut; new headgear combination.
runners.comment: 1-12 over fences; below par for a while now, including on recent stable debut

runners.name: Great d'Ange
runners.spotlight: Four-time chase winner but badly out of sorts before finishing second to a surprise winner over C&D 16 days ago (visor returned); remains to be seen if he'll be as good again and he may need more anyway.
runners.comment: Second to a 25-1 chance here last time; wouldn't be certain to repeat that effort

runners.name: Premier Fantasy
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in a hunter chase in 2025 on previous run over regulation fences; this multiple point winner can be given another chance and he's performed okay in two maiden hurdles for this yard.
runners.comment: Not disgraced in recent maiden hurdles; PU in previous chase but a multiple point winner

runners.name: Mirahmadi
runners.owner: SF Racing LLC, Starlight Racing Et Al

runners.name: Iron Man Cal

runners.owner: Bridlewood Farm, Don Alberto Stable Et Al

runners.name: Inbox
runners.owner: Hopeless Stables, Little Red Feather Racing Et Al

runners.name: Cortina d'Amprezzo
runners.owner: Hopeless Stables, Little Red Feather Racing Et Al

runners.name: Raiding Party
runners.owner: Larry R Rodgers, Coast Racing & Fick Farms

runners.name: Peanutbutterbombe
runners.owner: Little Red Feather Racing & William Strauss

runners.name: Light Won Up
runners.owner: Purple Rein Racing & Mark D Davis

races.race_name: Goffs Prix Robert Papin (Group 2) (Turf)

runners.name: King Of Cloughan
runners.spotlight: Made good progress on every start, and comes into this having won the Windsor Castle Stakes (6f, good to firm) at Royal Ascot about a month ago; shaped well over 7f prior to that behind another subsequent royal meeting winner, so unlikely to want this run at a dwadle.
runners.comment: Won the Windsor Castle Stakes and form before that stacks up well; good chance

runners.name: Beibhinn
runners.spotlight: Progressed, like her two rivals, with every run and was last seen finishing third in a 6f Group 2 at the Curragh for fillies on good to firm; figures suggest she has a bit to find but is the only one that gets the sex allowance.
runners.comment: Only filly in race but a little bit to do on the figures, albeit this might be tactical

runners.name: Tokaido
runners.spotlight: Hasn't looked back since debut second and has progressed with every run, landing the Group 3 Prix du Bois over 6f last time on what is likely to be similar ground; won twice here prior to that so obvious chance up against the two stablemates.
runners.comment: Been in good form in France and won a 6f Group 3 last time; takes on two stablemates

races.race_name: Prix de la Pepiniere (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Darley Prix Chloe (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)

runners.name: Jennifer Jane
runners.spotlight: Nowhere near her best in the Premio Oaks d'Italia (1m2.5f) when last seen despite having the run of the race, so better judged on her Listed win at Newmarket before that over 1m2f on good to firm from the front; could be hard to catch if allowed to dominate.
runners.comment: Nowhere near her best in the Premio Oaks d'Italia, but can go from the front

runners.name: La Fogata
runners.spotlight: Mostly exposed filly, who has run creditably at a decent level throughout her career; shown some improvement for this stable in 2026 but needs to do better than last time as Naas to pose a threat; stays beyond 1m2f and handles a sound surface.
runners.comment: Can run to a decent level but needs to do better than last time

runners.name: Pierchic
runners.spotlight: Useful for Charlie Appleby before joining this stable, and has two standout pieces of form, one of them last time in a mile Group 2 here over a furlong shorter, when beaten just under 3l; claims if producing her best form up a furlong in distance.
runners.comment: Has two standout pieces of form, one of them last time in a mile Group 2 here; player

runners.name: Maintain
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to the classy New Ground; won on debut and produced some respectable efforts this season, including last time under this rider in a 1m2f Listed event at Longchamp, when Ecija was third; may still be capable of better.
runners.comment: Sound effort under this rider last time; should be capable of better

runners.name: Ecija
runners.spotlight: Making steady improvement and beat Eklleel a short-neck in March over a mile on very soft; shaped nicely in Listed events since without winning one, albeit behind Maintain last time, and should be in the mix for a place.
runners.comment: Making steady improvement and should be in the mix for a place

runners.name: Eklleel
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to Saleymm, Saddadd and Almaqam, so bred to be a Group performer; made it fourth time lucky when winning at Lyon Parilly last time over a mile with a cosy success; step up in trip may bring about more improvement.
runners.comment: Well bred filly who should have more to come; interesting

runners.name: Lethal Beauty
runners.spotlight: Only win came on the AW but mostly on the up during her career and capable of a good effort, but was beaten 9l when last seen in May on very soft in a C&D Listed event; can be involved if the fitting of blinkers off a break sharpens her up.
runners.comment: Only win came on the AW but mostly on the up during her career

races.race_name: Prix Messidor (Group 3) (Turf)

runners.name: Silius
runners.spotlight: Consistent sort who had three of these behind when a short-head second in the 7f Group 3 Porte de la Maillot at Longchamp last time; no problem with the return to this trip and he's likely to give another good account.
runners.comment: Consistent sort who finished in front of three of these in G3 last time; claims

runners.name: Familly
runners.spotlight: Turned in her best effort to win soft-ground Listed event over 1m2f on reappearance and a respectable effort over the same trip in Group 3 last time; likely to be found out over this shorter trip on quicker ground, especially if this turns into a dawdle.
runners.comment: Improved performer this year but remains to see how she'll handle the step back in trip

runners.name: Erdenali
runners.spotlight: Progressive colt who made it three wins from as many starts when beating a previous winner in convincing fashion in a Listed event on his AW debut at Deauville last time; yet to race on a sound surface but he's got plenty of fast-ground influences in his pedigree and is an exciting sort who is capable of better; the one to beat.
runners.comment: Created a fine impression winning all three starts; quicker ground should pose no problem

runners.name: Dark Trooper
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner but one of his best efforts came in defeat in a strong Listed event at Doha in February; shaped well on his first run since when fourth in Group 3 at Longchamp last time; bit to find with Silius but should be better for that run and likely to get closer back at 1m.
runners.comment: Big chance on pick of his form and ran well after a break last time; sure to go well

runners.name: Matauri Bay
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive sort who ran well in a Group 3 over C&D on fast ground last time; no surprise should he get in the places once again.
runners.comment: Steadily progressive sort who ran well over C&D on fast ground last time; place prospect

runners.name: Fort Payne
runners.spotlight: Last year's Burj Nahaar winner (1m, dirt) at Meydan who returned to winning ways in a conditions event over 7f at Longchamp in spring; respectable effort in a Group 3 at the same course last month but faces a stiff task at these weights.
runners.comment: Respectable effort in a Group 3 last time but faces a stiff task on these terms
runners.owner: Alain Jathiere, Mme Philippe Demercastel & Nicolas Caullery

runners.name: King Gold
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner at Meydan (1m) and Longchamp (7f) last year but has yet to match either effort since then; shaped with more encouragement back on turf last time, where he's closely matched with Dark Trooper and Fort Payne; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Dual Group 3 winner last year and bit more encouragement last time; more needed
